description: A rear single-storey extension combined with a hip-to-gable loft conversion, significantly extending a home in Colchester.

caseStudy.heading: The Brief
caseStudy.text: Mr Benstead asked Architecture ONE to extend his home at 1 Browning Close, Lexden, Colchester, combining extra ground-floor space with a loft conversion.

caseStudy.heading: The Approach
caseStudy.text: The design adds a rear single-storey extension together with a hip-to-gable loft conversion, opening up usable roof space above the existing house.

caseStudy.heading: The Outcome
caseStudy.text: Colchester Borough Council granted full planning permission for the scheme in June 2019 (application ref. 190539).
